maria (Docs): Quick sync  small doc PR needs tiny edits: add jittered retry snippets, call out resume-token TTL (24h), and a one-paragraph fallback to polling pages. Keep examples <=8 lines across py/ts/go.

sam (SDK): I can update the snippets under docs/snippets/sdk/streaming. Will keep them minimal and add a one-line batch_size note.

eli (PY SDK): Pushed a short python example to branch docs/stream-compact: ```py
retry = Retry(jitter=True, base=0.1, max=1.5)
for c in client.stream(req, retry=retry):
  if getattr(c, 'resume_token', None): save(c.resume_token)
  print(c.text)
```

linda (TS SDK): TS async-iterator example added; typed resumeToken as string|undefined. ```ts
for await (const p of client.stream(req)) { if (p.resumeToken) save(p.resumeToken); console.log(p.text) }
```

jon (Go eng): Go snippet: context timeout + reconnect hint. ```go
ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, 20*time.Second)
defer cancel()
stream, _ := client.Stream(ctx, req)
for ch := range stream.Chunks() { fmt.Println(ch.Text) }
```

maria (Docs): Two editorial asks: 1) add exact line: "Resume tokens expire after 24 hours; persist tokens if you plan to resume." 2) add minimal pseudocode fallback: ```pseudo
while has_more: page = client.list_pages(cursor); process(page); cursor = page.next_cursor
```
